# Magic Wand Makeup Brushes Set: 5-Piece Wizard Wand Collection

Turn everyday makeup into something special with this 5-piece wizard wand brush set in a striking New Bronze finish. Each brush features a glittering, layered wand handle paired with tools for both face and eyes.

## Everything You Need for a Complete Look

This set includes a foundation brush, blush brush, eyeshadow brush, eyebrow brush, and lip brush. Use them to blend, contour, shade, and highlight, then reach for them again for powder and eyeliner. Each tool covers a specific step, so you can build a full look without switching kits.

## Crafted for a Comfortable, Confident Grip

The handles are made from high-polished metal alloy for a substantial, balanced feel in your hand. Soft, high-density synthetic bristles are cruelty-free and odor-free, and they're designed to minimize shedding for a smoother application.

## Portable Glamour for Every Day

Slip these brushes into your bag for touch-ups on the go. Their compact size makes it easy to keep your routine consistent, whether you're heading to class, the office, or a night out.

## A Thoughtful Gift for Someone Special

Looking for a gift that feels personal? Skip the ordinary bouquet and the usual jewelry. This wand set offers a fun, stylish surprise for a sister, friend, or anyone who loves makeup. Add a set to your cart today and give someone a little magic.
